# The Hindu

> India's leading English-language news publisher covering breaking news, analysis, opinion, and in-depth reporting from India and the world.

The Hindu publishes daily reporting across national and state news, politics, business, sport, science, arts, education, and lifestyle, alongside editorials, explainers, videos, podcasts, and premium journalism.

## Main News Hubs
- [Home](https://www.thehindu.com/): Front page with top headlines, breaking news, and featured coverage across sections.
- [News](https://www.thehindu.com/news/): Central news hub aggregating national, international, state, and city reporting.
- [Latest News](https://www.thehindu.com/latest-news/): Continuously updated stream of the newest published stories and developments.
- [Breaking News](https://www.thehindu.com/news/breaking-news/): Live and fast-moving coverage of major events and urgent developments.
- [Videos](https://www.thehindu.com/videos/): News videos, explainers, interviews, and visual reports across beats.
- [Podcasts](https://www.thehindu.com/podcasts/): Audio journalism, news analysis, and topic-focused podcast episodes.

## India News
- [National](https://www.thehindu.com/news/national/): Reporting on Indian politics, government, policy, law, and public affairs.
- [States](https://www.thehindu.com/news/national/): Broader India coverage with links into state-level reporting and regional developments.
- [Cities](https://www.thehindu.com/news/cities/): Local reporting from major Indian cities on civic and urban issues.
- [Tamil Nadu](https://www.thehindu.com/news/national/tamil-nadu/): State news, politics, governance, and regional developments from Tamil Nadu.
- [Karnataka](https://www.thehindu.com/news/national/karnataka/): Coverage of Karnataka politics, Bengaluru, policy, and state affairs.
- [Kerala](https://www.thehindu.com/news/national/kerala/): News and analysis from Kerala on politics, society, and governance.
- [Andhra Pradesh](https://www.thehindu.com/news/national/andhra-pradesh/): State reporting on politics, administration, and public issues in Andhra Pradesh.
- [Telangana](https://www.thehindu.com/news/national/telangana/): Telangana news covering Hyderabad, politics, and state developments.

## World & Geopolitics
- [International](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/): Global news coverage spanning diplomacy, conflict, elections, and world affairs.
- [World](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/): International reporting and analysis on major global developments.
- [Russia-Ukraine Conflict](https://www.thehindu.com/topic/Russia-Ukraine_conflict/): Topic page collecting reports, analysis, and updates on the war.
- [Israel-Palestine Conflict](https://www.thehindu.com/topic/Israel-Palestine_conflict/): Coverage of conflict developments, diplomacy, and humanitarian issues.
- [Ground Zero](https://www.thehindu.com/topic/Ground_Zero/): On-the-ground reporting and special coverage from conflict regions.
- [Diplomacy](https://www.thehindu.com/topic/diplomacy/): Stories focused on foreign policy, bilateral ties, and negotiations.

## Politics, Elections & Policy
- [Politics](https://www.thehindu.com/news/national/politics/): Indian political reporting, party developments, and parliamentary coverage.
- [Elections](https://www.thehindu.com/elections/): Election news, results, analysis, and constituency-level developments.
- [Parliament Proceedings](https://www.thehindu.com/topic/parliament-proceedings/): Coverage of debates, bills, disruptions, and legislative business.
- [Supreme Court](https://www.thehindu.com/topic/supreme-court/): Legal reporting on major judgments, hearings, and constitutional matters.
- [Governors](https://www.thehindu.com/topic/governors/): News and analysis involving gubernatorial offices and constitutional questions.
- [Public Policy](https://www.thehindu.com/topic/public-policy/): Reporting on policy design, implementation, and governance outcomes.

## Business & Economy
- [Business](https://www.thehindu.com/business/): Business news covering markets, companies, economy, and policy.
- [Economy](https://www.thehindu.com/business/Economy/): Macroeconomy, inflation, growth, fiscal policy, and economic indicators.
- [Markets](https://www.thehindu.com/business/markets/): Stock market news, trading trends, and investor-focused updates.
- [Industry](https://www.thehindu.com/business/Industry/): Corporate developments, manufacturing, infrastructure, and sectoral reporting.
- [Budget](https://www.thehindu.com/business/budget/): Union Budget coverage, analysis, and tax and spending implications.
- [Agri-Business](https://www.thehindu.com/business/agri-business/): Agriculture markets, farm economy, and rural business reporting.
- [Real Estate](https://www.thehindu.com/business/real-estate/): Property market trends, housing policy, and real estate industry news.

## Sport
- [Sport](https://www.thehindu.com/sport/): Main sports hub with scores, reports, previews, and analysis.
- [Cricket](https://www.thehindu.com/sport/cricket/): Match reports, series coverage, player news, and cricket analysis.
- [Football](https://www.thehindu.com/sport/football/): Domestic and international football news, results, and features.
- [Tennis](https://www.thehindu.com/sport/tennis/): Tournament coverage, player updates, and match analysis.
- [Hockey](https://www.thehindu.com/sport/hockey/): Indian and international hockey reporting and tournament updates.
- [Athletics](https://www.thehindu.com/sport/athletics/): Track and field coverage, results, and athlete profiles.
- [Motorsport](https://www.thehindu.com/sport/motorsport/): Racing news, event coverage, and motorsport features.

## Science, Technology & Health
- [Science](https://www.thehindu.com/sci-tech/science/): Research, space, environment, and scientific discovery coverage.
- [Technology](https://www.thehindu.com/sci-tech/technology/): Tech industry news, gadgets, platforms, and digital policy reporting.
- [Health](https://www.thehindu.com/sci-tech/health/): Public health, medicine, disease, wellness, and healthcare system coverage.
- [Environment](https://www.thehindu.com/sci-tech/energy-and-environment/): Climate, conservation, energy transition, and environmental policy stories.
- [ISRO](https://www.thehindu.com/topic/isro/): Space mission updates, launches, and Indian space programme coverage.
- [Artificial Intelligence](https://www.thehindu.com/topic/artificial-intelligence/): Reporting on AI tools, regulation, and industry developments.

## Opinion & Analysis
- [Opinion](https://www.thehindu.com/opinion/): Editorials, columns, op-eds, and expert commentary on current affairs.
- [Editorial](https://www.thehindu.com/opinion/editorial/): The Hindu's institutional editorials on major public issues.
- [Lead](https://www.thehindu.com/opinion/lead/): Long-form opinion essays and analytical commentary.
- [Columns](https://www.thehindu.com/opinion/columns/): Recurring columnist perspectives on politics, society, and policy.
- [Comment](https://www.thehindu.com/opinion/comment/): Shorter opinion pieces and issue-based commentary.
- [Readers' Editor](https://www.thehindu.com/opinion/readers-editor/): Accountability, corrections, and editorial standards discussions.

## Arts, Culture & Entertainment
- [Entertainment](https://www.thehindu.com/entertainment/): Film, television, music, streaming, and celebrity coverage.
- [Movies](https://www.thehindu.com/entertainment/movies/): Film news, reviews, interviews, and festival coverage.
- [Music](https://www.thehindu.com/entertainment/music/): Classical, contemporary, and independent music reporting and reviews.
- [Art](https://www.thehindu.com/entertainment/art/): Visual arts coverage, exhibitions, artists, and cultural commentary.
- [Theatre](https://www.thehindu.com/entertainment/theatre/): Stage productions, reviews, and theatre-related features.
- [Dance](https://www.thehindu.com/entertainment/dance/): Classical and contemporary dance coverage, reviews, and profiles.
- [Books](https://www.thehindu.com/books/): Book reviews, author interviews, literary essays, and publishing news.

## Life, Society & Education
- [Life & Style](https://www.thehindu.com/life-and-style/): Lifestyle reporting on food, fashion, travel, and modern living.
- [Society](https://www.thehindu.com/society/): Social issues, inequality, gender, rights, and community-focused reporting.
- [Education](https://www.thehindu.com/education/): School, higher education, exams, policy, and career-related coverage.
- [Careers](https://www.thehindu.com/education/careers/): Career guidance, jobs, skills, and professional development stories.
- [Children](https://www.thehindu.com/children/): News, features, and educational content for younger readers.
- [Food](https://www.thehindu.com/life-and-style/food/): Recipes, restaurant features, culinary trends, and food culture.
- [Travel](https://www.thehindu.com/life-and-style/travel/): Destination features, travel writing, and tourism-related stories.

## Data, Explainers & Special Features
- [Data](https://www.thehindu.com/data/): Data journalism, charts, and evidence-based explanatory reporting.
- [Explained](https://www.thehindu.com/news/national/explained/): Explainers unpacking complex news events, policy, and background context.
- [In Focus](https://www.thehindu.com/podcast/in-focus-podcast/): Deep-dive analysis tied to major news developments and issues.
- [Specials](https://www.thehindu.com/specials/): Curated packages and thematic special coverage collections.
- [Topic Index](https://www.thehindu.com/topic/): Topic pages aggregating coverage around people, places, and issues.
- [Archive](https://www.thehindu.com/archive/): Historical archive of past editions, stories, and published content.

## Premium & Subscriber Services
- [Premium](https://www.thehindu.com/premium/): Subscriber-focused journalism, exclusives, and in-depth reporting.
- [Subscription Plans](https://www.thehindu.com/subscription/): Digital subscription options, pricing, and access details.
- [Today's Paper](https://www.thehindu.com/todays-paper/): Digital access to the day's newspaper edition and sections.
- [ePaper](https://epaper.thehindu.com/): Replica newspaper experience for subscribers and print-style reading.
- [Crossword+](https://www.thehindu.com/crossword/): Crossword and puzzle offerings associated with subscriber engagement.
- [Newsletter](https://www.thehindu.com/newsletter/): Email newsletters delivering curated headlines and section updates.
